summary: Jade Biosciences, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 3, 2026 to disclose entry into an underwriting agreement for an underwritten public offering of 10,000,000 shares of common stock at $15.00 per share, with a $14.10 per share purchase price for underwriters. The filing is a routine capital raise via an existing shelf registration statement (Form S-3), not a special situation. The offering is expected to close June 5, 2026 and proceeds of ~$140.3 million will fund general corporate purposes. No activist campaign, acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other control event is involved.
